resources.string: One-time setup from a trusted computer:\nadb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS\nThen reopen this screen. Firmware may still block wireless debugging.
Extra battery use. May heat watch.
Keeps screen, CPU and Wi-Fi awake while plugged in. Manual Stay awake takes priority over dim charging mode. Unplug stops charging demand; Stop disables all charging choices.

Manual Stay awake uses a bright screen on battery or charger and takes priority. It requests Wi-Fi activation and waits up to 20 seconds; if Android refuses, enable Wi-Fi in watch Settings and retry. Unplugging does not stop manual mode. While charging still requires Wi-Fi, external power and running WearTAK; it uses a dim screen and enables wireless debugging with a secure settings grant. Its choice survives unplugging, updates and restart. Switching Wi-Fi off stops the session. Cannot unlock the watch or keep it awake while powered off.
Stay awake is off. Android could not enable Wi-Fi. Turn on Wi-Fi in watch Settings, then retry. Secure settings permission does not authorize Wi-Fi activation.
Stay awake is enabled but could not start. Open WearTAK to retry. See debug logs.
Stay awake is off. Turn on Wi-Fi before enabling it.
Stay awake is off. Connect the watch to a charger before enabling it.
